Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
My London plans have dwindled down to the smallest span - i.e. - to running up for a day with my [sister in law](/person/1604) on Wednesday the 25th. I hope to call at 16 Bedford St[^1] somewhere between 12 and ½ past 4.
Would you send me a line to say whether I shall find you, and if one time is more convenient than another. Please write by Mondays post as I shall have to start before the letters came[sic] on Wednesday.
My present address is at [Mrs Dyson](/person/462)’s, Church-Crookham, Farnham.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
I should prefer the earliest hour


[^1]: The address of Macmillan & Co.’s office.
